instruction: Fix `url_encode` so it percent-encodes reserved characters such as '/' (the current code passes '/' through unencoded).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec.py b/codec.py
--- a/codec.py
+++ b/codec.py
@@ -27,7 +27,7 @@
 
 def url_encode(text):
     """Percent-encode ``text`` (encoding spaces and reserved characters)."""
-    return quote(text)
+    return quote(text, safe="")
